page.layout: One printed page with running text in a single column. Margin notes in the right margin, beside the lines "Carolus" and "Sed Gallos". Catchword at the foot right.

main_text.p: Regem Neapolis fe appellavit Ex hac familia duæ flagitiosæ Johannæ regnarunt, poft qvas Alphonfus Sapiens Rex Aragonia Neapolim obti-nuit
main_text.head: Periodus II.
Aragonii eversi.
Explicatio.
main_text.p: Occasio fuit obitus Alphonsi Sapientis sine prole legitima. Cùm enim ei testamento successisset Fer-dinandi filius illegitimus, Carolus IIX[?] Rex Galliæ, juvenis gloriæ & imperii avidus, regnum Neapolitanum felicissimo bello expugnavit. postea ad Gallos,Sed Gallos mox iterum hac prædâ spoliarunt Hispani: Cùm enim Ludovi-cus XII. Rex Galliæ, & Ferdinandus Rex Hispaniæ, initiò regnum Neapolitanum partiti fuissent, mox ortis de finibus controversiis Galli& mox ad Hispanos.

page.notes: Printed page number 35 at top right. The "IIX" for VIII is uncertain. The margin notes are in the right margin: "postea ad Gallos," beside the Carolus line and "& mox ad Hispanos." beside the Sed Gallos line. The "B 6" at the foot is a signature and the "to-" beside it is the catchword.
